scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:region" "npm run dev:global"
scripts.dev:global: node init && NODE_ENV=development BUILD_PATH=dist node server/global
scripts.dev:region: node init && NODE_ENV=development BUILD_PATH=dist nodemon --watch src --watch dist -- --experimental-loader ./loader/region.js --conditions=react-server server/region
scripts.start: node init && concurrently "npm run start:region" "npm run start:global"
